items.briefing:
Macquarie Technology Group has launched a dedicated security centre aimed at supporting Australian universities, which is worth noting as the education sector — including registered training organisations — continues to be a target for cyber threats. Separately, new regulations around Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) services are putting pressure on Australian businesses to maintain accurate customer data, as poor data quality is increasingly being exploited for fraud.

Interestingly, research shows many Australians still trust physical mail more than digital communications — a reminder that staff should stay alert to physical mail-based scams, not just email phishing.

**Practical tip:** Remind staff to verify unexpected postal correspondence claiming to be from banks, government agencies, or suppliers before acting on it.

featured.title: Macquarie launches security centre for universities
featured.quote: Universities face October cyber deadline with new local monitoring support from Macquarie.
